pages.title: Home
pages.description: Frame the multi-session conference and drive registration from a central hub.

sections.intent: Establish brand and conference identity at the top of the hub.
sections.reason: An events team visitor needs immediate recognition that this is the official conference hub before scrolling further.

sections.intent: Provide a prominent registration prompt for the multi-session conference.
sections.reason: The primary action is registering for the whole conference; placing it high reduces friction for teams deciding whether to commit.

sections.intent: Summarize the conference scope, dates, and multi-track value.
sections.reason: Teams running multi-track conferences need to quickly grasp whether this event matches their professional interests before exploring details.

sections.intent: Highlight headline speakers, tracks, or sponsors that make this edition compelling.
sections.reason: Events teams compare conferences by keynotes and prestige; featuring marquee names builds urgency and validates the registration decision.

sections.intent: Show quotes from past attendees or organizers who ran similar multi-track events.
sections.reason: Social proof matters when committing staff time and budget; testimonials from peers in events teams lower perceived risk.

sections.intent: Close the homepage with practical next steps or a note on group registration.
sections.reason: A footer text section ensures late-scrolling visitors have a clear path to act without a harsh dead-end, reinforcing the hub role.

sections.intent: Display a condensed grid or timeline of sessions, tracks, and breaks.
sections.reason: Events teams evaluate whether the schedule offers enough depth across tracks for their different staff roles before committing to register.

sections.intent: Introduce each speaker with a short bio and their session topic.
sections.reason: Knowing who is on stage helps events teams judge expertise and session quality, which drives the decision to register and attend specific tracks.

sections.intent: Explain accessibility, room setup, and nearby accommodation.
sections.reason: Logistics are a gatekeeper for events teams; clear venue information removes a common blocker for multi-session conference registration.
